name: MixedSwapRouter
fix_description: The router allows arbitrary calls that can be used to transferFrom tokens approved by users. Fix _validatePoolTokens to properly restrict which target contracts and function selectors can be called, preventing arbitrary token transfers from users who approved the router.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is not a simple one-call bug: it requires understanding the router’s swap/callback flow, crafting a fake pool contract, and abusing callback parameters to make the victim pay as the payer. Although the PoC is fairly short, it involves multiple contracts, CREATE2 setup, and protocol-specific logic rather than an obvious generic pattern.
